description:
Wallet Report: Base balances, top tokens, USD totals for any address.  Returns: a wallet snapshot on Base: the native ETH balance, nonce, whether the address is a contract, and its balances of ten major Base tokens (WETH, USDC, USDbC, DAI, cbETH, wstETH, cbBTC, AERO, VIRTUAL, DEGEN), with USD for ETH, WETH and dollar stablecoins. One batched read, cached 60 seconds; no other tokens, no labels.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_eth_reads_v1/base_wallet_snapshot. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_eth_reads_v1__base_wallet_snapshot
